item.title: Why Chat Is Not the Future of AI UX
item.content:encoded: When people interact with AI capabilities in a product, chat is only one surface option, and it’s not always the right choice. Let’s explore other options.

item.title: I Did a Thing: The Friction of Letting an Agentic Workflow Do the Work
item.content:encoded: Building with agents feels like farming badly. The agentic workflow isn’t broken. I’m leading something I don’t understand yet, and that’s a leadership problem.

item.title: Enhancing the Default Navigation Menu in Blazor
item.content:encoded: Learn different ways to improve the default navigation system, from those that allow replacing Blazor’s characteristic sidebar menu to those that can serve as a complement to a main navigation system.

item.title: Creating a Copy Code Button in Kendo UI for Vue
item.content:encoded: Let’s create a copy code button for the Kendo UI for Vue Editor. It automatically uses the correct styling and the built-in copy icon.

item.title: Replicating Project Pad UI in .NET MAUI
item.content:encoded: Recreate this modern UI from scratch using .NET MAUI to experiment with common features like BindableLayout and next-level components like Telerik UI for .NET MAUI CollectionView.

item.title: Build Lightweight APIs That Run Anywhere with Hono
item.content:encoded: Learn about Hono routing techniques, context management, middleware patterns, server-side rendering with JSX and how to deploy an app to Cloudflare Workers.

item.title: How to Model Money in ASP.NET Core
item.content:encoded: Working with monetary values in C# seems simple until improper implementation introduces rounding errors, inconsistencies and financial losses that are difficult to detect. Learn best practices for coding financial systems in ASP.NET Core.

item.title: React for Vue Developers, Part 4: Forms, useFormStatus and useOptimistic
item.content:encoded: React 19 for Vue 3 Developers, Part 4: Where in Vue you use `v-model` and `ref` or use a library, React leans on the plain HTML `<form>` and hooks.

item.title: AI Engineering Skills Roadmap
item.content:encoded: Let’s map out a route for learning the AI stack. Follow these four phases, building on your existing developer skills, to map your learning plan.

item.title: Advanced AI Observability: Context, Loop Detection and Token Counts with Progress Agent Engineering
item.content:encoded: With observability, we can connect agent behavior to real business cases, catch performance bottlenecks and keep costs more predictable.

item.title: Blazor Basics: Common Blazor Mistakes Beginners Make (and How to Avoid Them)
item.content:encoded: One Blazor specialist shares common mistakes he sees beginner Blazor web developers make and tips for how to avoid them.

item.title: Getting Started with the .NET MAUI Map Control
item.content:encoded: See how the Telerik UI for .NET MAUI Map control lets you display maps, labels and regions to add things like world maps or seating charts to your apps.

item.title: Using Kendo UI with Svelte
item.content:encoded: Even though there isn’t a native Svelte Kendo UI library, you can still use the Kendo UI for jQuery library of components with Svelte.

item.title: Build a Real-Time Collaborative Notes App with Replicache
item.content:encoded: Build a real-time collaborative notes app with Replicache where users can create, edit, delete notes and react with emojis. We will see every change we make sync instantly across all open browser tabs.

item.title: Model Selection Criteria
item.content:encoded: How do you decide what model to use? Let’s look at workload, deployment, regulated environments and other criteria for selecting the right AI model.
